test_patchify_simple: test the PatchifyTokenizer encode and decode round-trip on random image data
run_extract_patches: run extract_patches to reshape a tensor into non-overlapping spatial patches of a given size
run_merge_patches: run merge_patches to reconstruct a spatial tensor from flattened patch sequences
create_PatchifyTokenizer: create a PatchifyTokenizer instance with a specified patch size for encoding image trajectories
test_encode_decode_roundtrip: test that encoding then decoding with PatchifyTokenizer produces the original tensor values
